name: discovery.consulagent

arguments.name: datacenter
arguments.description: Data center in which the Consul Agent is configured to run. If not provided, the data center is retrieved from the local Consul Agent.

arguments.name: refresh_interval
arguments.description: Frequency to refresh list of containers.

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.description: The scheme to use when talking to the Consul Agent.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Host and port of the Consul Agent API.

arguments.name: services
arguments.description: A list of services for which targets are retrieved. If omitted, all services are scraped.

arguments.name: tag_separator
arguments.description: The string by which Consul tags are joined into the tag label.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: An optional list of tags used to filter nodes for a given service. Services must contain all tags in the list.

arguments.name: token
arguments.description: Secret token used to access the Consul Agent API.

blocks.description: Configure TLS settings for connecting to the endpoint.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The set of targets discovered from the Consul Agent API.
